overview.title: Bass Lab II 5 — Abyssal Machinery (reconstructed reference)
overview.description: Deep moving drone-bass with independent harmonic and amplitude cycles. Five independently shaped sub/body/texture branches. Reconstructed from the delivered source graph with new IDs.
overview.instructions: Import and play from zero. Four bars at 80 BPM (12 seconds), then loop. Solo patch; common backing only in independent preview. Native playback unverified; start at low monitoring level.
